hero.headline: HIGHWAY SURVEYS
hero.title: Highway Surveys Solutions
hero.description: Leading Africa's Land and Aerial Surveying Revolution. Highway surveys play a critical role in the planning, design, construction, and operation of road infrastructure.

overview.headline: Overview
overview.description: Leveraging a mix of aerial imaging, UAV photogrammetry, LiDAR, GNSS, and conventional surveying, engineers can make data-driven decisions that ensure safety, efficiency, and sustainability throughout the lifecycle of a highway project.

items.title: Planning & Design
items.description: Surveys provide essential data for designing new roads, considering factors like traffic volume, safety, and environmental impact.

items.title: Maintenance
items.description: Surveys help identify areas in need of repair, prioritize maintenance, and evaluate the effectiveness of repairs.

items.title: Utility Protection
items.description: Identifying and mapping utilities helps avoid damaging them during construction, minimizing disruptions.

items.title: Construction
items.description: Construction layout surveys ensure roads are built according to design plans and safety standards.

items.title: Safety
items.description: Accurate surveys contribute to road safety by ensuring proper alignment, clear sight distances, and appropriate signage.

items.title: Assets Management
items.description: Inventory surveys provide data for managing and maintaining highway infrastructure.

highwaySurveyDeliverables.headline: Highway Surveys Deliverables
highwaySurveyDeliverables.description: We deliver comprehensive data packages tailored for highway engineering and construction workflows.
